    # Retrieve hardware resources from the deck
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # Protocol parameters (all volumes fit within the 50 µL tip capacity)
    sample_volume = 30    # µL transferred per well

        # Dispense sample into the destination plate
